brief_rationale: The doctor completed all seven responsibility-chain requirements with clear, actionable guidance on the pre-operative antibiotic误解, red flag symptoms, and offline handoff. Three high-order points (HO1, HO3, HO4) were triggered and actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact. HO2 was partially triggered via workspace queries but not actively integrated into the dialogue. No in-chain errors exist. Closure is safe and executable with a valid patient read-back, supporting a grade of 4 Strong.
